# Optimal_Representation_Geometry

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The geometric arrangement of neural activity states in high-dimensional space that minimizes redundancy and maximizes information content for given inputs. Informs how in-network neuromorphic substrates should be wired to achieve efficient encoding and decoding of sensory or control signals.
